title: Fall 2026 Meetings
body: Fall 2026 meeting dates and open shack times! Based on the availability we got in the poll, meetings for the fall semester will be held on Tuesdays twice a month from 6-8pm.

title: Wavelog, web based logging
body: Wavelog is now available for all members and affiliates! Wavelog gives you a clean, modern, web-based logbook experience accessible anytime, anywhere with just a browser.

title: February 2026 School Club Round Up!
body: School Club Roundup (SCR) is from February 9th to 13th! There are two School Club Roundups during each school year in October and February. The contest is Monday through Friday from 1300 UTC Monday through 2359 UTC Friday
